title: Hero Journey Modpack |Performance only|
description: A modpack made to boost performance during Hero Journey Missions
body:
## Description
This modpack is intened to boost performance on the Hero Journey Club Minecraft server.
Whilst in the lobby I was able to get up to 300 FPS when walking around on my main pc.

Main pc specs (For referances)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- RTX 2060
- AMD ryzen 5 3600
- 32 GBS of ram


</details>
Performance gain varry between systems. Don't expect to get the same FPS boost as I did
 
 ### Extra Info
 
 The modpack comes equiped with an FPS metor and battery metor for laptops 
 - (Modpage says  batery display only works on windows)

 The Hero Journey Server IP is not added by defalt in order to protect the server from hackers, etc. You can go to their website for more info on Hero Journey herojourney.club

 - This modpack is not affiliated with hero journey club. If they want this project taken down then I will take it down
